gridLayout.portrait-left: Portrait on the left + 2 on the right
gridLayout.portrait-right: Portrait on the right + 2 on the left

autoHint: Automatic: images in the same row have the same height, without being cropped. A very wide backdrop takes the full width.
keepShapeHint: Free format: images in a row get the same height. To keep the large cells of this layout, pick a format (Square, 4:3…).
justifyHint: Free format: images in the same row have the same height, without being cropped.

hint.strip: The project's images in a strip that scrolls sideways.
hint.grid: Images or videos arranged in columns.
hint.image: A single image, up to full width.
hint.video-single: A video from your media library.
hint.free-board: Cut-out images placed wherever you like, at the size and angle you want.
hint.rich-text: A paragraph, with a title if you want.

hint.loop: Loop: the video plays in a loop, without sound. One click pauses it, another restarts it.
hint.player: Player: one click opens the video full size, with its controls and sound.

hint.on: Sound on: the video plays with sound as soon as the visitor starts it (the browser requires a click first).
hint.off: Sound off: the video starts without sound; the sound button turns it back on.
